summary: GEO supplies raw counts for the registered six Gr3 and eight vehicle hypothalamus libraries. The authors’ RNA-seq results cover liver, epididymal white adipose tissue and skeletal muscle. Their gene-labelled hypothalamic results measure protein abundance seven hours after a single dose, so the public evidence cannot test the registered RNA effect.

manualReview.summary: The deposited library IDs support the Gr3 versus vehicle hypothalamus contrast. Published results cover different tissues or assays.
manualReview.note: The GEO count columns and sample records identify eight Vhcl and six retained Gr3 hypothalamus libraries. The preparation excludes Gr3_rep_31_Hy and Gr3_rep_30_Hy. Extended Data Fig. 4 explicitly labels peripheral libraries by drug. Joining those IDs to GEO establishes the group key across all 95 displayed libraries, with Gr3 assigned to GLP-1/GIP and Gr2 to GLP-1/GIP/Lani. The registered group-only edgeR model estimates Gr3 minus vehicle RNA log2 fold change. The hypothalamic Fig. 5k–m data come from acute mass spectrometry. No gene-level author RNA result was located for the registered cohort.
reviewFlags: GEO describes seven daily treatments and collection 24 hours after the last dose. Supplementary Methods link the published bulk RNA analysis to a 12-day experiment. Individual hypothalamus records give a group code and omit dosing duration and sex. The paper describes male mice.
The review establishes library selection and treatment identity. The available results leave author RNA effects, P values, FDR and concordance unassessed for hypothalamus.
The legacy preparation lacks a committed source-file checksum manifest. SOURCES.tsv fingerprints the public files retrieved for this review.

verificationReview.reason: The registered result is bulk hypothalamic RNA log2 fold change for six Gr3 GLP-1/GIP libraries versus eight vehicle libraries, excluding two repeat-labelled libraries. The reported RNA Wald tests and gene lists use peripheral libraries. Fig. 5k–m and Extended Data Fig. 9b describe a separate single-dose, seven-hour hypothalamic protein experiment with protein-level ANOVA, pairwise tests and enrichment. GEO supplies sample counts, without an author contrast statistic.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen on release of gene-level hypothalamic RNA effects or a signed, labelled author result for Gr3 versus vehicle, with the GSM or library IDs, handling of the two repeat libraries, and a dosing/harvest record that reconciles the seven- and 12-day descriptions. Assess any selected results only within their published scope.
